title: Håstad tester seed
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Håstad tester seed consists of two sign vectors $x,y\in\{\pm1\}^n$, a sign $b\in\{\pm1\}$, and a sign vector $z\in\{\pm1\}^n$ representing the noisy version of the coordinatewise product $bxy$.
